adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed rework closed the prior generic blocker by extracting source-located MIC, CC50, and HC50 rows; matching linked DBAASP assay rows back to primary source data; preserving database-name/VEP-label conflicts as cautions; and replacing automated mechanism notes with source-bounded membrane-assay claims.
summary: Accepted with cautions after bounded local source recovery; all blocking worker-2, worker-4, and worker-6 issues from rwk-complete-test-0001 are repaired or converted to explicit nonblocking cautions.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Linked literature rows were checked against article metadata, Supplementary Table 2 sequences, and merged catalog rows. DBAASP assay rows were matched to source-located Fig. 2a and Supplementary Table 3 values; database alias/name conflicts remain explicit cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 repair now contains source-located MIC matrix records for 58 VEPs across 11 organisms plus CC50 and HC50 rows from Supplementary Table 3, with units, targets, assay context, and locators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Automated mechanism placeholders were replaced with source-bounded membrane depolarization, outer membrane permeabilization, and secondary-structure context claims; no protein-synthesis or host-immune mechanism is promoted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_final_review: The previous full_source_review_not_completed blocker is closed because XML/PDF/OA package/supplement/database rows were reopened and adjudicated into final artifacts.

caution_findings.evidence_context: 440 linked database audit rows remain source_conflict because database peptide names or aliases differ from primary VEP labels even when sequence/activity values are source-supported.
Figure 2a source-data value 80 was represented as >64 µM based on the paper method range of 1-64 µmol L-1; raw source context is preserved in each MIC row.
Very large CC50/HC50 nonlinear-regression values in Supplementary Table 3 are retained as raw reported values rather than normalized or capped.
